purpose: One-read asset-and-time-disjoint evaluation of a WaveField veto over an asset-normalized post-capitulation event head.

source.integrity: Every archive file must pass the provider CHECKSUM before it enters a gzip bundle.

development.labels_used_for_training: Only 13 development assets from the training period.

normalization.feature_policy: All causal numeric event-cache features except hour_sin, hour_cos, weekday_sin, and weekday_cos.

candidate_event.threshold_scope: per asset using only feature history before the evaluated period
candidate_event.overlap_control: At most one candidate per asset until the previous 24h forecast matures.

extra_trees_head.sample_weight: inverse number of training events sharing the same timestamp

wavefield_veto.decision: Emit an up forecast only when both the ExtraTrees head and the positive-vs-negative WaveField resonance pass their frozen thresholds.

dependence_control.utc_market_blocks: Group selected asset forecasts by UTC day.
dependence_control.market_episodes: Merge selected UTC blocks separated by no more than 48h.
dependence_control.episode_label: Hit when the median signed future return of selected assets is positive.

holdout_policy: No symbol, feature, normalization, model parameter, field parameter, threshold, fold, direction, or gate may change after this file is committed. Failed gates remain reported.
